# Bento

> Bento is a self-contained office suite: one HTML file is the document, the viewer and the editor. Bento Slides is the presentation app. The document is plain JSON inside the file's `<script type="application/bento+json" id="bento-doc">` block; an AI agent edits that block in place, or hands the running app a JSON string. Every saved deck names its schema in a top-level `$schema` key.

## Docs

- [Agent authoring guide](https://bento.page/agents.md): how to write and edit a deck, with copy-paste snippets; the compact input form (omit defaults, place content by layout and role); a worked example per feature (click builds, code morph, maths, frames, tokens and modes, components, paint stacks); every finding validate() reports; a field reference of every key, generated from the code
- [Field reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nyblnet/bento/main/plugins/bento-slides/skills/bento-slides/references/format.md): every key of the format with its type, allowed values and meaning, generated from the app's tables (the same text as the guide's last section)
- [Compact input reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nyblnet/bento/main/plugins/bento-slides/skills/bento-slides/references/compact.md): the built-in layouts, their roles and slots, and every default a compact document may leave out
- [Finding codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nyblnet/bento/main/plugins/bento-slides/skills/bento-slides/references/verify.md): every code validate() and bento check report, with severity and meaning
- [Document schema](https://bento.page/schema/slides.json): JSON Schema 2020-12 for the `#bento-doc` JSON, generated from the app's own validation tables; version-pinned copies live beside it (`slides-<version>.json`)
- [Platform invariants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nyblnet/bento/main/docs/PLATFORM.md): what every Bento file promises (splice contract, additivity, identity)
- [The app](https://bento.page/slides): opens with the starter deck; `window.bento` exposes `read()` (the document, sharing keys left out: the read call for agents), `loadDoc(json)`, `compact()`, `validate()`, `measure()`, `schema()`, `comments()`, and the raw `doc` / `serialize()`, which carry the deck's sharing keys

## Optional

- [Decision log](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nyblnet/bento/main/docs/DECISIONS.md): why the format and the runtime are the way they are
- [Source](https://github.com/nyblnet/bento)
